# Flow IL v1 contract fixtures

These fixtures are generated by the backend-side reference compiler in
`tools/generate-flow-il-v1-fixtures.mjs`. It performs deterministic Kahn
scheduling and typed slot allocation, then emits the canonical contract from
`docs/flow-il-v1-contract.md`.

Regenerate intentionally with `node tools/generate-flow-il-v1-fixtures.mjs`.
Verify without writing with:

```text
node tools/generate-flow-il-v1-fixtures.mjs --check
```

Valid source-order permutations must remain byte-identical. Invalid artifacts
are mutations applied only after canonical compilation, and their expected
stable reason/path are checked independently by C and .NET tests.
